plugins.description: The exoskeleton for your AI coding agent: memory across sessions, a live code map, undo for every change and a fact check of every name, file and number it states. MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI. Install first: pipx install "imperal-mcp[code]" (or uv tool install "imperal-mcp[code]"; any Python from 3.7).
